name: James A. Flaten
role: Associate Director of the MN Space Grant Consortium and Contract Professor
research_summary: Flaten leads hands-on NASA-related education and projects involving high-altitude balloons, miniature spacecraft, rocket payloads, and student rocketry. His academic background is experimental low-temperature physics, and his outreach connects physics with sound, art, and engaging demonstrations.
